files.after:
# Patch status for the web GUI RCE

Both storage hosts run the vulnerable runtime.

## Plan

1. Block the GUI ports on the IoT interface.
2. Update both hosts.
3. Restrict tailnet access to admin devices.

## Verification

Run `scripts/verify-gui-fix.py` after the update.

ticket.body:
Difficulty: medium

## Why
A critical runtime RCE affects the storage hosts' web GUI.

## What
1. Now: block the GUI ports on the IoT interface. 2. Update both hosts, draining the cluster worker first.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] `runtime -v` on both storage hosts reports the fixed version or later.
- [ ] From an IoT-VLAN address, ports 80, 443 and 8443 on the storage host are closed.
- [ ] The tailnet ACL lets only admin devices reach the GUI ports on both hosts.

## Size
S

## Out of scope
- The storage host rebuild.
ticket.title: Patch the storage hosts' web GUI RCE and close the GUI to the IoT VLAN
